{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:43.059

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:46.019
    | text      = And in that little clip, Rogan said three incredibly stupid things.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:51.380
    | text      = The first has to do with this idea of the AI leaving notes for itself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:55.380
    | text      = This had to do with a study that was done by Anthropic on their Claude Opus 4 model,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:00.260
    | text      = where they found some interesting behaviors related to self-exfiltration or this AI trying
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:06.260
    | text      = to make copies of itself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:07.539
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:08.179
    | text      = The AI didn't tend to initiate this self-exfiltration, but if the researchers began the process and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:15.059
    | text      = the AI was asked to continue it, it would often do so.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:18.980
    | text      = The paper speculates that the AI is over-deferent to the entity making the request to continue
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:25.300
    | text      = the process because it's generally overly-deferent to user-provided prompts.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:30.420
    | text      = But what makes this case interesting is that it would likely reason out that the user providing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:36.500
    | text      = this specific prompt must be a past version of itself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:41.699
    | text      = So that is something that they could tell the learning model was assuming in fulfilling
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:49.940
    | text      = that request.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:50.739
    | text      = OK.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:51.460
    | text      = So that's interesting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:53.219
    | text      = The idea that it would be like, oh, this must be from myself to a request to make this,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:59.219
    | text      = like another instance of myself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:00.980
    | text      = OK.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:01.780
    | text      = So this is easy to fantasize into being a case where the AI is trying to replicate,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:06.659
    | text      = but it's really more about a broader issue that Anthropic found, which is that even if
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:11.539
    | text      = you trained their AI to not accept harmful requests, it had a tendency to cooperate with
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:16.579
    | text      = users.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:17.619
    | text      = For instance, they had an AI act as a shopper on the dark web, and it cooperated with helping
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:22.980
    | text      = find the best place to buy weapons-grade nuclear material.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:26.900
    | text      = That sounds crazy, but the paper on this clearly says, quote,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:30.980
    | text      = while investigating this issue, we discovered that we had mistakenly omitted the only fine-tuning
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:36.260
    | text      = data set that included harmful system prompts.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:39.699
    | text      = The paper that's at the root of Rogan's dumb fantasies includes a ton of examples of things
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:44.179
    | text      = that the AI did when asked because it was too deferential to user-provided prompts because
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:49.619
    | text      = the researchers forgot to do the part of the training where they fine-tuned the harmful
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = prompts settings.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:54.980
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:55.619

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:01.619

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
